title: stachys recta subsp. hirta
intro: Stachys recta subsp. hirta, commonly known as Hedge Woundwort, is a plant species belonging to the Lamiaceae family. It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties. The therapeutic actions of Hedge Woundwort include wound healing, pain relief, and the management of digestive issues. Bioactive constituents present in the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and volatile oils, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
